name: delivery-record
description: Schema-typed, human-signed Delivery Records for AI-assisted work. Generate a record for any significant output (code PR, FRD, audit, discovery, design handoff, strategy, client comms, QA, launch, deployment, devops, project setup, ongoing improvement) with a mandatory named-reviewer checkpoint, then verify records against the bundled JSON Schema spec with the threshold rule (fail needs a waiver, n/a needs a justification).
